requirement_vague: Ensure an authenticated user cannot change their email to an email already registered by another account.
requirement_precise: Register a new normal user and obtain an access token. Register a second user with a different random email. Using the access token for the first (authenticated) user, attempt to update the authenticated user's email to the email of the already-registered second user. Verify the response status is 409. Verify the response body contains a JSON field "detail" with the value "User with this email already exists".

implementation.reasoning: The authenticated self-update endpoint checks whether the requested new email belongs to another existing user and, if so, raises an HTTP 409 response. The error body uses FastAPI's standard JSON error format with a "detail" field set to "User with this email already exists", matching the requirement.
